items.summary: Recommendation: Approve only three bounded, report-only baselines for findyourlostpets.com, dumbsluts.com, and eastcoastrappers.com. Reject production work, financial claims, credential/configuration changes, spending, and new high-priority queue work because attribution, telemetry, and measured outcomes are unavailable or insufficient. Existing active and measuring work should continue to its stated gates.
